# Barcelona Games

> Barcelona Games is a social sports club in Barcelona, Spain. For companies it runs Olympic-style team building (2 to 6 hours, 10 to 50 people) and multi-day corporate retreats (2 to 4 nights, 10 to 40 people) in a private villa in Catalonia, led by two co-hosts with a full planned itinerary. Retreats and team building can also be organised anywhere else on request, including internationally. Founder: Quentin Patrouillard. Language: English.

## For companies and HR teams
- [Olympic-style company retreat, co-hosted and fully planned](https://playbarcelonagames.com/olympic-company-retreat/): quick answer, "at a glance" facts, who leads it, the real hour-by-hour itinerary of our first retreat (16-18 Oct 2026, Pyrenees), a sample 3-day company itinerary, and FAQ.
- [Corporate retreats in Catalonia](https://playbarcelonagames.com/corporate-retreats/): private villa about 2 hours from Barcelona, sleeps 28 (second residence nearby for up to 40), private chef, breathwork and meditation, photo and video team. About EUR 10,000 to 20,000.
- [Team building in Barcelona and Catalonia](https://playbarcelonagames.com/team-building/): games-led sessions of 2 to 6 hours for 10 to 50 people, on the beach, in Montjuic or at your own venue. From EUR 700.
- [For companies](https://playbarcelonagames.com/for-companies/): chooses between the two formats.

## Key facts
- Led by two co-hosts (Quentin Patrouillard plus a co-host leader) and a small assistant team.
- Format: teams with bandanas, relay, trust and coordination games, a live scoreboard, medals, opening and closing ceremony. 80+ games in the library.
- Retreat length: 2 to 4 nights, standard Friday to Sunday. Group size: 10 to 40.
- Booking lead time: about 2 months for weekends, 1 month for weekdays (retreats); 2 to 3 weeks minimum for team building.
- First retreat (Weekend Games, 16-18 Oct 2026, Pyrenees) also included an outdoor jacuzzi, a secret hunt, games developed in secret during the weekend and a closing ceremony recognising everyone. That retreat was social, for people meeting each other; a company retreat uses the same format around one team.
- Contact: use the booking form on any company page. Public phone number is intentionally not listed.
